messages:
maria: Heads-up — saw weird drift in A/B signals when branch-throttle + telemetry-sampling are both on. Variant B shows p95 spike but only in sampled telemetry.

devon: Same sighting. Seems like sampling biases away warmup traces so observer undercounts cold starts.

aj: Could also be batching differentials — sampled traces might pick up different sequence lengths.

lucas: Quick idea: expose a deterministic sampling seed from control plane so runtime and observer sample the same requests. e.g. X-Rollout-Seed header derived from user_id hash.

kevin: Important tradeoff: deterministic header helps correlation but leaks stable identifiers. We need to support privacy-safe seeds (e.g. salted hash per-customer) and document for Private installs.

sre-bot: alert: variant_b.error_rate > 0.5% (5m) fired at 4310007710 — acknowledged.

maria: Interface boundary thought: keep policy decisions in control plane (who gets traffic) and sampling coordination metadata in rollout spec. Runtime only reads header to align sampling. No control-plane decisions from sampled metrics.

devon: Alternative: mark a tiny percent of canary requests as "full-trace" (no sampling) and tag them. Upside = no seeded headers; downside = cost.

aj: Implementation compromise: add rollout.metadata fields: sampling_strategy = ("seeded"|"random"|"full-trace"), sampling_rate, seed_salt. Runtime and observer honour sampling_strategy for that route.

lucas: Minimal API patch: runtime v2 /routes/{id}/rollout -> { metadata: { sampling_strategy, sampling_rate, seed_salt } }. Sidecar can inject X-Rollout-Seed = hmac(seed_salt, tenant_id) % 10000.

kevin: Ops plan: gate behind FF, opt-in per-route. Start with sampling_rate=0.5% full-trace + seeded_sampling for general traces. Measure noise delta for 2 weeks. If noise < 1% promote.

maria: Also need cache-warmup hint. Add rollout.metadata.prefetch = true/false and eviction_protect = duration. This helps KG/kv cache differences between variants.

aj: Small code snippet for sidecar header injection:
```http
# pseudocode
seed = hmac(seed_salt, tenant_id)
if (hash(request.user_id) % 10000 < sampling_rate*10000) {
  req.headers['X-Rollout-Seed'] = seed
}
```

devon: Test matrix: (1) seeded vs random sampling, (2) prefetch on/off, (3) full-trace fraction. Need p95, tail-rt, model-token-loss, and embed error rate.

lucas: I'll own RFC + lightweight PoC. Plan: open PR with API proto + sidecar patch. Timeline: PoC in 2 weeks, validation run for 2 weeks.

kevin: Ops checklist: feature-flag, per-customer salt rotation plan, docs for Private KMS + privacy guidance, alert tuning to avoid sampling-induced flaps.

maria: Decision summary: agree to pursue seeded sampling + small full-trace fraction + rollout metadata for prefetch/eviction_protect. Owner Lucas. Followup RFC + PoC.

sre-bot: Action items recorded: Lucas#create-rfc, aj#proto-sidecar, devon#validation-plan.
